description: Three ways for a crowd to answer a mix, shared by name rather than copied per entity (ADR-097). Nothing here names an asset, a size or a place: every target is a node property every node has, so the same library dresses a city square, a club and a field of standing stones. A scene says "entityProfiles": "crowd.profiles.json" once and each entity says "profile": "dancer".

dancer.description: Answers the low end hard and the top lightly, and walks between whatever a field pulls it towards. The bass is slow to let go, which is what stops a crowd reading as a strobe.

onlooker.description: Stands, watches, and answers a quarter as much. The one that makes a crowd read as a crowd rather than as a chorus line, because a room where everybody dances is as flat as a room where nobody does.

lamp.description: Not a character: a prop with reactions and no behaviours, which ADR-088 already allowed and ADR-097 makes spatial. Point it at a field's occupancy and a light answers a room filling up rather than answering the music directly.
